args.name: enum_and_creds
args.source:
#!/bin/bash
echo '=== Interfaces ==='
ip addr show
echo '=== Routes ==='
ip route show
echo '=== SSH keys ==='
find / -name 'id_rsa' -o -name 'id_ed25519' -o -name 'id_dsa' -o -name 'authorized_keys' 2>/dev/null | head -20
echo '=== Config files ==='
find /etc -type f \( -name '*.conf' -o -name '*.cfg' -o -name '*.ini' \) 2>/dev/null | head -30
echo '=== Password files ==='
grep -r 'password' /etc 2>/dev/null | head -10
